column1: # OWASP ZAP alert overrides for the CI DAST target.
# Only informational / environment-specific noise is ignored. Injection,
# auth-bypass, and other High/Critical classes still fail the job (-l FAIL).

column3: (CSP) CI target already sends a CSP; some ZAP versions still warn.
(X-Content-Type-Options) Already set on the DAST target.
(X-Frame-Options) Already set on the DAST target.
(X-XSS-Protection) Already set on the DAST target.
(HSTS) TLS is terminated at the edge, not on http://localhost.
(Content Security Policy) Already set on the DAST target.
(Permissions Policy) Already set on the DAST target.
(Private IP disclosure) Expected for a localhost DAST target.
(Timestamp disclosure) /health includes an indexer timestamp by spec.
(Server header version leak) Node default; stripped in production.
(HTTP to HTTPS) Local DAST target is HTTP by design.
(Re-examine Cache-control) Public GET catalog routes may be cached.
(Storable/cacheable content) Public GET catalog routes may be cached.
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) API uses wallet signatures / API keys.
